literal: Son to father rendering help: 'this man's father what penance did he perform, I wonder' saying word.
translation: The greatest help a son can render his father is to live so well that the world asks, 'What penance did his father perform to beget him?'
modern: ஒரு மகன் தன் தந்தைக்குச் செய்யும் கைம்மாறு, இவனுடைய தந்தை இவனைப் பிள்ளையாகப் பெற என்ன தவம் செய்தானோ என்று உலகத்தார் வியந்து கூறும் சொல்லைப் பெற்றுத் தருவதே ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate gratitude a son can show his father. The word 'உதவி' (help) here means the reciprocal duty or return a son owes. The greatest return is not material wealth, but living such an exemplary life that onlookers marvel at it. They will wonder aloud, 'என் நோற்றான் கொல்' (what penance did he perform?), implying the father must have done great austerities to be blessed with such a son. Thus, earning this specific word of praise from the world is the highest tribute a son can pay.
